about: Think Tank Showdown question pools per level. Rounds: Riddle Rush (answer), Rebus Round (rebus: show = rows; tokens [big:X] [small:X] [up:X] [down:X], row [line]), Logic Puzzles (logic: checked by a solver, exactly one answer; M.3 puzzles have one red herring clue), Final Wager (wager: bet any points, ALL IN). M.3 Riddle Rush includes trick questions (herring: true). Each round has a pool (qs); every new game draws "play" main and "spares" spare questions at random. todo = something for Henry to check.

rounds.name: Riddle Rush
rounds.rule: 45 seconds. Write ONE answer. Hold it up on "Show me!" · 1 point

qs.q: What has a face and two hands, but no arms or legs?
qs.why: A clock has a face and two hands: the hour hand and the minute hand.

qs.q: What has to be broken before you can use it?
qs.why: You break an egg before you cook it.

qs.q: What goes up but never comes down?
qs.why: Every birthday your age goes up. It never goes down!

qs.q: I have lots of teeth, but I can't bite. What am I?
qs.why: Also accept: a zip / a saw.

qs.q: What has legs but can't walk?
qs.why: Also accept: a chair / a bed.

qs.q: What is full of holes but can still hold water?
What can you hear but not see or touch? You use it when you speak.
What gets bigger the more you take away from it?
qs.why: Dig more and the hole gets bigger!

qs.q: What goes up when the rain comes down?
qs.why: You open it when it rains.

qs.q: What has one head, one foot and four legs?
qs.why: The head and foot of the bed, and four legs.

qs.q: I am yellow and I shine in the day. What am I?
What has a mouth but never eats, and a bed but never sleeps?
qs.why: The mouth and bed of a river.

qs.q: What can you break without touching it?
What has lots of words but never speaks?
qs.why: Also accept: a dictionary / a newspaper.

qs.q: What has a ring but no finger?
I have cities but no houses, and rivers but no water. What am I?
What has a head and a tail but no body?
What is white when it is dirty and black when it is clean?
What can fill a room but takes up no space?
What starts with T, ends with T, and has T in it?

rounds.name: Logic Puzzles
rounds.rule: 60 with your team. Read every clue. Write ONE answer · Right = 2 points

qs.q:
Ann, Ben and Cat each have one pet: a dog, a cat or a fish.
• Ann's pet lives in water.
• Ben does not have a dog.
Who has the dog?
qs.why: Ann has the fish. Ben has no dog, so Ben has the cat and Cat has the dog.

qs.q:
Tom, Mia and Joe each like one color: red, blue or green.
• Tom likes the color of the sky.
• Mia does not like green.
What color does Joe like?
qs.why: Tom likes blue. Mia doesn't like green, so Mia likes red and Joe likes green.

qs.q:
Sam, Lily and Max each play one sport: soccer, swimming or tennis.
• Lily's sport is in the water.
• Max does not play soccer.
What does Sam play?
qs.why: Lily swims. Max doesn't play soccer, so Max plays tennis and Sam plays soccer.

qs.q:
Nok, Ploy and Bank each eat one fruit: a mango, a banana or an apple.
• Nok's fruit is long and yellow.
• Bank does not eat the apple.
Who eats the apple?
qs.why: Nok has the banana. Bank has no apple, so Bank has the mango and Ploy has the apple.

qs.q:
Amy, Ben and Kim each drink one thing: milk, juice or water.
• Amy's drink is white.
• Kim does not drink water.
What does Ben drink?
qs.why: Amy drinks milk. Kim doesn't drink water, so Kim drinks juice and Ben drinks water.

qs.q:
Leo, Ava and Zac go to school by bike, by bus or by car.
• Leo goes with lots of other students.
• Ava's way to school has two wheels.
How does Zac go to school?
qs.why: Leo takes the bus and Ava rides a bike, so Zac goes by car.

qs.q:
Dan, Eve and Fay live on floors 1, 2 and 3 of the same building.
• Dan lives on the top floor.
• Eve lives above Fay.
Who lives on floor 1?
qs.why: Dan is on floor 3. Eve is above Fay, so Eve is on 2 and Fay is on 1.

qs.q:
Gus, Hana and Ivy are 10, 11 and 12 years old.
• Gus is older than Hana.
• Ivy is older than Gus.
Who is the youngest?
qs.why: Ivy is older than Gus, and Gus is older than Hana. So Hana is the youngest (10).

rounds.name: Final Wager
rounds.rule: BEFORE you see it: bet any of your points (ALL IN = all of them). Right = win your bet · Wrong = lose it

qs.q: A farmer has 5 cows. All but 2 run away. How many cows are left?
qs.why: "All but 2" means "all of them except 2". So 2 cows stay.
qs.todo: "All but 2" may be new English for M.1: explain it after the answer.

qs.q: Which month has 28 days?
qs.why: Every month has at least 28 days!

qs.q: How many legs do 3 chickens have?
Take half of 10, then add 2. What is the answer?
Today is Monday. What day will it be in 3 days?
A dog is bigger than a cat. A cat is bigger than a mouse. Which is the smallest?
How many months have 31 days?
qs.why: January, March, May, July, August, October and December.

qs.q: I have 2 coins. Together they make 15 baht. One of them is not a 5-baht coin. What are they?
qs.why: One is not a 5-baht coin (it is the 10). The other one is!

rounds.name: Riddle Rush
rounds.rule: 40 seconds. Write ONE answer. Hold it up on "Show me!" · 1 point

qs.q: What can travel around the world while staying in a corner?
qs.why: A stamp stays in the corner of an envelope while the letter travels.

qs.q: What has a neck but no head?
qs.why: Also accept: a shirt / a guitar.

qs.q: What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?
qs.why: Other people say your name much more often than you do.

qs.q: I'm tall when I'm young and short when I'm old. What am I?
qs.why: A candle gets shorter as it burns.

qs.q: What has one eye but can't see?
qs.why: The thread goes through the needle's eye.

qs.q: What can you hold in your right hand but never in your left hand?
What comes down but never goes up?
I have keys but no locks, and space but no room. What am I?
What has a thumb and four fingers but is not alive?
What goes through cities and fields but never moves?
qs.why: Also accept: a railway / a path.

qs.q: What can't talk but answers when you speak to it?
What has a bottom at the top?
qs.why: Your bottom is at the top of your legs!

qs.q: What invention lets you look right through a wall?
If you drop me, I crack. If you smile at me, I smile back. What am I?
What kind of room has no doors or windows?
What is so fragile that saying its name breaks it?
What has 13 hearts but no other body parts?
Which word is spelled wrong in every dictionary?
What goes up and down but doesn't move?
I am an odd number. Take away one letter and I become even. What number am I?

rounds.name: Logic Puzzles
rounds.rule: 2 minutes with your team. Read every clue. Write ONE answer · Right = 2 points

qs.q:
Alex, Beth and Chris each have a favorite pet (cat, dog or bird) and a favorite fruit (apple, banana or cherry).
• Alex does not like apples and does not own a cat.
• The person who likes apples owns a bird.
• Beth owns a cat and loves bananas.
• Chris does not like cherries.
Who owns the dog, and what is their favorite fruit?
qs.why: Beth: cat + banana. Chris doesn't like cherries, so Chris likes apples and owns the bird. Alex has the dog and cherries.

qs.q:
Dee, Eli and Fon each have one hobby (drawing, singing or dancing) and one snack (chips, cookies or popcorn).
• Eli sings.
• The dancer eats popcorn.
• Dee does not dance and does not eat cookies.
What does Eli eat?
qs.why: Eli sings and Dee doesn't dance, so Dee draws and Fon dances (popcorn). Dee has no cookies, so Dee eats chips and Eli eats cookies.

qs.q:
Gam, Hugo and Iris are going to Japan, France or Brazil. Each has a red, blue or green bag.
• Hugo's bag is red.
• The person going to Japan has a green bag.
• Iris is going to Brazil.
Where is Hugo going?
qs.why: Hugo's bag is red, so he isn't going to Japan (green). Iris goes to Brazil, so Hugo goes to France.

qs.q:
Jay, Kai and Lin are 12, 13 and 14. Each wants to be a doctor, a chef or a pilot.
• The pilot is the oldest.
• Kai is 12.
• Lin wants to be a chef.
• Jay is older than Lin.
What does Kai want to be?
qs.why: Jay is 14 and Lin is 13. The oldest (Jay) is the pilot, Lin is the chef, so Kai wants to be a doctor.

qs.q:
Mo, Nan and Oak each play one sport (basketball, badminton or running) on Monday, Wednesday or Friday.
• Nan plays badminton.
• The runner trains on Friday.
• Mo trains on Monday.
• Oak does not play basketball.
Who trains on Wednesday, and what sport do they play?
qs.why: Oak runs (Friday). Mo plays basketball on Monday, so Nan plays badminton on Wednesday.

qs.q:
Pim, Quinn and Rose sit in the front, middle or back row. Each likes math, art or science best.
• Rose sits in the back.
• The person in the front likes science.
• Pim does not sit in the middle.
• Quinn likes art.
Which subject does Rose like?
qs.why: Pim sits in the front (science), Quinn likes art, so Rose likes math.

qs.q:
Sun, Tao and Uma have a black, white or pink phone. Each likes chess, puzzles or cards.
• Uma's phone is pink.
• Sun plays chess.
• The person with the white phone plays cards.
• Tao's phone is not black.
Who likes puzzles, and what color is their phone?
qs.why: Tao has the white phone and plays cards. Sun plays chess, so Uma (pink phone) likes puzzles.

qs.q:
Vic, Wan and Xia live in a yellow, blue or white house. Each has a rabbit, a hamster or a turtle.
• Wan lives in the blue house.
• The turtle lives in the white house.
• Vic has a hamster.
• Xia's house is not yellow.
Who has the rabbit?
qs.why: Xia lives in the white house with the turtle. Vic has the hamster, so Wan has the rabbit.

rounds.name: Final Wager
rounds.rule: BEFORE you see it: bet any of your points (ALL IN = all of them). Right = win your bet · Wrong = lose it

qs.q: You are running a race and you pass the person in second place. What place are you in now?
qs.why: You took their place. The person you passed is now third.

qs.q: A bat and a ball cost 110 baht together. The bat costs 100 baht more than the ball. How much is the ball?
qs.why: Ball 5 + bat 105 = 110. (Not 10 baht: then the bat is 110 and the total is 120.)

qs.q: There are 3 apples. You take away 2. How many apples do YOU have?
Which is heavier: a kilo of feathers or a kilo of stones?
qs.a: Neither: they both weigh a kilo.

qs.q: A doctor gives you 3 pills. Take one every 30 minutes. How many minutes until they are all gone?
qs.why: One now, one at 30 minutes, one at 60 minutes.

qs.q: How many times do you write the number 1 when you count from 1 to 20?
What is the next number? 2, 4, 8, 16, …
Which is correct: "The yolk of the egg is white" or "The yolk of the egg are white"?

rounds.name: Riddle Rush
rounds.rule: 40 seconds. Write ONE answer. Hold it up on "Show me!" · 1 point

qs.q: What has keys but can't open locks?
qs.why: Also accept: a keyboard / a computer keyboard.

qs.q: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
qs.why: Every step you take leaves a footprint behind you.

qs.q: What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
qs.why: Look at the spelling: minute, moMent, thousand years.

qs.q: Before Mount Everest was discovered, what was the highest mountain in the world?
qs.why: It was still the highest. People just didn't know yet!

qs.q: What can you catch but not throw?
qs.why: Also accept: a cough / the flu.

qs.q: What gets wetter the more it dries?
What is always coming but never arrives?
qs.why: When it arrives, it is today.

qs.q: What can be cracked, made, told and played?
What begins with E, ends with E, but usually has only one letter in it?
What word becomes shorter when you add two letters to it?
Forwards I am heavy, but backwards I am not. What am I?
What can you hold without touching it?
If you have me, you want to share me. If you share me, you haven't got me. What am I?
A man walked in the rain with no umbrella or hat, but not one hair on his head got wet. Why?
What can you see once in a year, twice in a week, but never in a day?
qs.why: Look at the spelling: yEar, wEEk, day.

qs.q: What has to be answered but never asks a question?
I have branches but no fruit, trunk or leaves. What am I?
qs.why: Banks have branches in many towns.

qs.q: Which room do ghosts never go into?
Two fathers and two sons go fishing. They catch three fish and each gets one. How?
qs.a: There are only 3 people: a grandfather, a father and a son.

qs.q: What four-letter word reads the same forwards, backwards and upside down?
How many of each animal did Moses take on the ark?
qs.why: 🐟 Red herring! It was Noah, not Moses, who built the ark.

qs.q: A plane crashes on the border of Thailand and Laos. Where do they bury the survivors?
qs.why: 🐟 Red herring! You don't bury survivors: they are alive!

qs.q: Some months have 31 days. How many months have 28 days?
qs.why: 🐟 Red herring! Every month has at least 28 days.

qs.q: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many are left?
A rooster lays an egg on top of a roof. Which way does the egg roll?
qs.why: 🐟 Red herring! Roosters don't lay eggs.

qs.q: If a red house is made of red bricks and a blue house is made of blue bricks, what is a greenhouse made of?
qs.why: 🐟 Red herring! A greenhouse is the glass house for plants.

qs.q: What do cows drink?
qs.why: 🐟 Red herring! Not milk! Cows make milk, but they drink water.

qs.q: An electric train is going north. The wind is blowing south. Which way does the smoke go?
qs.why: 🐟 Red herring! Electric trains don't make smoke.

qs.q: Mary's father has five daughters: Nana, Nene, Nini and Nono. What is the fifth daughter's name?
qs.why: 🐟 Red herring! The question tells you: Mary's father.

qs.q: A boy fell off a 10-meter ladder but didn't get hurt. How?
qs.a: He fell off the bottom step
qs.why: 🐟 Red herring! Nobody said he was at the top.

qs.q: Where does Thursday come before Wednesday?
qs.why: 🐟 Red herring! T comes before W in A to Z order.

rounds.name: Logic Puzzles
rounds.rule: 2 minutes with your team. Read every clue. Write ONE answer · Right = 2 points · Careful: one clue is a red herring!

qs.q:
Ana, Bo, Cy and Di sit in seats 1-4. They drink coffee, tea, juice or water.
• Ana sits in seat 1.
• The tea drinker sits next to Ana.
• Di's favorite color is green.
• Cy drinks water and sits in seat 4.
• Bo does not drink tea.
• The juice drinker sits next to the water drinker.
What does Ana drink, and who sits in seat 2?
qs.why: Tea is in seat 2, and Bo doesn't drink tea, so Di is in seat 2 and Bo in seat 3. Juice is next to water (seat 4), so Bo has juice and Ana has coffee. Red herring: Di's favorite color.

qs.q:
Ben, Cara and Dev are in the drama, robotics or music club. The clubs meet on Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday.
• The robotics club meets the day after the drama club.
• Cara is in the music club.
• The music club has the most members.
• Dev's club meets on Monday.
• Ben is not in the drama club.
On which day does Cara's club meet?
qs.why: Ben is in robotics, so Dev is in drama (Monday). Robotics is the next day (Tuesday), so music (Cara) is Wednesday. Red herring: the number of members.

qs.q:
Eli, Fah, Gus and Hong live on floors 1-4. Pets: a cat, dog, bird and fish.
• The dog lives on the floor right above the cat.
• Fah lives on floor 1 and has a fish.
• The building has a lift.
• Gus lives on the top floor.
• Eli has the bird.
• Hong does not live on floor 2.
Who has the dog, and on which floor?
qs.why: Fah 1, Gus 4, Hong 3, Eli 2 (bird). The dog is right above the cat, so Hong (3) has the cat and Gus (4) has the dog. Red herring: the lift.

qs.q:
Ivy, Jon and Kit ran a race and finished 1st, 2nd and 3rd. Their shirts were red, green and yellow.
• The runner in red finished just before the runner in yellow.
• Jon finished last.
• It was raining during the race.
• Kit's shirt was not red.
• Ivy did not win.
What color was the winner wearing?
qs.why: Jon was 3rd and Ivy wasn't 1st, so Kit won and Ivy was 2nd. Red is just before yellow, and Kit isn't red: Ivy red, Jon yellow, Kit green. Red herring: the rain.

qs.q:
Lek, May and Nut came at 6, 7 or 8 p.m. with cake, fruit or drinks.
• Whoever brought drinks came first.
• May arrived before Nut.
• The party was on a Saturday.
• Lek brought cake.
• Nut did not bring drinks.
• Lek arrived last.
When did Nut arrive, and what did Nut bring?
qs.why: Lek brought cake and Nut didn't bring drinks, so May brought drinks and came first (6). Lek came last (8), so Nut came at 7 with fruit. Red herring: Saturday.

qs.q:
Opal, Pete, Rin and Sai are 13, 14, 15 and 16. Each plays the piano, guitar, drums or violin.
• The drummer is the oldest.
• Rin is 13 and does not play the piano.
• Two of them have birthdays in May.
• Pete is older than Opal but younger than Sai.
• Opal plays the violin.
Who plays the piano, and how old are they?
qs.why: Rin is 13, so Opal 14, Pete 15, Sai 16 (drums). Opal plays violin, Rin isn't piano (guitar), so Pete plays piano. Red herring: the birthdays.

qs.q:
Tan, Ung and Vee ordered pizza, pad thai or a burger. Each paid by cash, card or phone.
• The burger was paid by card.
• Tan paid with his phone.
• The restaurant was very busy.
• Ung did not order the burger.
• The pizza was not paid with a phone.
What did Tan order?
qs.why: Tan paid by phone, so no burger (card) and no pizza. Tan ordered pad thai. Red herring: the busy restaurant.

qs.q:
Wit, Xen and Yui each have a poster of Mars, Saturn or Jupiter on a blue, gray or white wall.
• Yui's poster is Saturn.
• The Mars poster is on a white wall.
• Saturn has rings.
• Wit's wall is gray.
• Xen's poster is not Jupiter.
Whose wall is blue, and which planet is on it?
qs.why: Xen has Mars (white wall). Wit (gray) has Jupiter, so Yui has Saturn on the blue wall. Red herring: Saturn's rings.

rounds.name: Final Wager
rounds.rule: BEFORE you see it: bet any of your points (ALL IN = all of them). Right = win your bet · Wrong = lose it

qs.q: A girl has as many brothers as sisters. Each brother has only half as many brothers as sisters. How many brothers and sisters are in the family?
qs.why: The girl sees 3 other sisters and 3 brothers. A brother sees 2 brothers and 4 sisters (2 is half of 4).

qs.q: How many times can you take 10 away from 100?
qs.why: After that, you are taking 10 away from 90!

qs.q: 5 machines make 5 phones in 5 minutes. How long do 100 machines take to make 100 phones?
qs.why: Each machine makes one phone in 5 minutes.

qs.q: A water plant doubles in size every day. It covers a lake in 30 days. On which day did it cover half the lake?
qs.why: It doubles from half to full on the last day.

qs.q: What is the next number? 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, …
You are in a race and you pass the person in LAST place. What place are you in now?
qs.a: It's impossible: nobody is behind the last person.

qs.q: A father has five daughters. Each daughter has one brother. How many children are there?
qs.why: Five daughters and ONE brother (they share him).

qs.q: You write all the numbers from 1 to 100. How many times do you write the number 9?
